method: Actual isolated Electron Main/Preload/EngineSupervisor, Vite, signed DLC, registered typed operations/ActionRun/Representation. Playwright controls real UI. No model calls, no fake Renderer or domain writes.

download_boundary.native_save_path: Verification-only will-download item.setSavePath; fixed filenames under isolated workspace output/playwright; Electron receives and writes bytes. Listener removed after two Native done events.

initial_download_diagnostics.cdp_allow: Representation 200, Blob fetch 200 and correct digest, Native item received full bytes but done interrupted with empty savePath. CDP reported canceled. This was not counted as success.
initial_download_diagnostics.cdp_default_without_save_path: Native item received full bytes, remained progressing with empty savePath awaiting native save selection; later canceled when isolated app closed.

scope_cancellation.method: Hold delivery of real Session GET 200 using route.fetch, switch UI project, release unchanged response, return to original project; finally unroute. Read-only existing store selectors inspect tabs.

lifecycle.method: Official DLC settings disable, explicit Engine restart, reenable and restart. No internal store mutations.
lifecycle.transient_restart_observation: One /dlcs/activation connection refused while the previous Sidecar port closed; subsequent fresh reload recovered.

limitations: Scripted capability bench proves mechanism and domain outcomes, not actual LLM creativity.
Native Save dialog clicks were not automated.
10,000-node full load still used 102 pages and 19.60 seconds on this machine.
Adversarial review is a separate unfinished stage.
